notes: A NEW LOOK, LETTERHEAD VOUCHERS AND FASTER ENTRY. The menu is new: your everyday screens sit at the top and the rest fold into groups under More; nothing has been removed, and search still finds every screen. Payment vouchers, journals, receipts and the other printed documents now carry one full letterhead with your crest at full size; add your parent organisation and a telephone or email line under Settings, Organisation and Branding. Payments shows totals at a glance, All, Drafts and Posted tabs, one main button per row with the rest under a More menu, and entry in a panel beside the list. Entry is quicker: Enter moves to the next field, Ctrl+S saves, Save and new keeps the date and bank, T in a date box means today, and you can attach the invoice while you enter. The dashboard starts with what needs you: drafts, unreconciled accounts, overdue staff advances and lines over budget. Withholdings lists payees with no TIN so you can fill them in before the return. Carries everything in 0.6.140. Installing: no migration and no change to your data. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
